This '''guard''' was a member of the [[Fromm Gang/Legends|Fromm Gang]] criminal organization during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="P170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> the guard caught the young [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Kea Moll]] and [[Jord Dusat]] attempting to sneak aboard gang leader [[Sise Fromm]]'s [[Sise Fromm's starship|starship]].
